name: Investor Residency (Golden / Silver Visa)

requirements.blocker_text: At least OMR 500,000 invested in an Omani limited liability company, public joint stock company, or government bonds; or real estate worth at least OMR 500,000; or a company employing at least 50 Omani nationals (no minimum investment for this option).
requirements.fix_path: Make a qualifying investment of at least OMR 500,000, or establish a company employing 50+ Omani nationals.

requirements.blocker_text: Applicant must be over 21 with no criminal record and sufficient funds for self and dependents.
At least OMR 250,000 invested in an Omani limited liability company or public joint stock company, or real estate worth at least OMR 250,000.
requirements.fix_path: Make a qualifying investment of at least OMR 250,000.

requirements.blocker_text: Applicant must be over 21 with no criminal record and sufficient funds for self and dependents.

evidence_required.document: Proof of qualifying investment (bank/company/real estate records)
Proof of sufficient funds for self and dependents

sources.title: Trowers & Hamlins (law firm) -- Oman's relaunched Golden Visa (OMR 500,000, 10 years) and Silver Visa (OMR 250,000, 5 years) programmes, effective from the 31 August 2025 relaunch, application fees OMR 551/OMR 326

Sultanate of Oman -- official Golden Residency Program portal, confirms a 10-year residency track and lists qualifying pathways (business investment, tourism-zone property, bonds/listed shares, fixed-term deposit, employing 50+ Omanis, nomination by an invested company) but did not surface the specific OMR figures or a Silver-tier breakdown in this pass

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Oman). STATUS: DRAFT -- an official Omani government portal (omanresidence.gov.om) for this exact program exists and is cited, but its fetched content did not reproduce the OMR 500,000/250,000 figures or confirm a distinct 'Silver' tier by name; those specific numbers are corroborated only by a law firm's summary (tier-3) of the program's August 2025 relaunch, not independently verified against a tier-1 page in this pass. This is Oman's closest equivalent to a long-term/indefinite residency status, since the country has no separate 'permanent residence' category (see om_naturalisation.json's notes) -- Golden/Silver Visa holders instead renew indefinitely by maintaining the qualifying investment.
